synthesis: The streaming migration reduced median end-to-end latency from 4.8 h to 1.8 h (62% reduction) in Q3. Two sources corroborate: the pipeline metrics dashboard shows 1.8 h median for Q3 against a Q1-Q2 baseline of 4.8 h, and the cloud cost report attributes the 18% per-job spend reduction largely to eliminated reprocessing triggered by missed SLAs. The incident tracker independently confirms 0 data-loss incidents in Q3 versus 11 in H1. No single source covers all four metrics, so synthesis across three sources is required.
gap: The legacy domain migration completed in week 9 of Q3; its post-migration latency measurement covers only 3 of 13 weeks and may not represent steady-state performance.
